plan: Represent session state separately from deterministic screen construction.
Validate each structured action before committing a copied candidate state.
Inject action source and screen sink ports for standard-library unittest fakes.
mechanisms: A fixed-key public session dictionary holds authoritative check-in state.
Private screen builders enforce exact prompt, message, and choice shapes.
Copy-then-commit action handling prevents malformed or invalid actions from corrupting accepted data.
Dependency-injected read_action() and display() ports support replaceable console I/O.
